title: Tri Pattie's Pointers
subtitle: 19 tips from Pattie Wallner.
emptyMessage: The Tri Pattie's Pointers episodes aren't published yet. They'll appear here as soon as they are, with no app update needed.

pointers.title: Mud In Shoes
pointers.summary: You're at a race where it's been raining and the transition area is grass and it's full of mud.

pointers.title: Phone# On Shoe
pointers.summary: You've just finished your race, you're tired.

pointers.title: Bring A Backpack
pointers.summary: It's race day morning and you have a backpack and it's full of all of your transition bags, fuel bottles, special needs bags, it's heavy.

pointers.title: Breaking Bad Outfit
pointers.summary: It's race day morning or it's a freezing cold training morning and you're going to be standing around for hours, even at a marathon.

pointers.title: Right Size Baggie
pointers.summary: It's a really windy day out and either out for a long training ride or it's on race day and you just pulled into an age station.

pointers.title: Freezer Bag
pointers.summary: You've come out of your swim, you're exiting T1, and you got a steep decline or it's a little chilly out.

pointers.title: Wind Vs. Flat Tire
pointers.summary: You've got a flat tire and you're on the side of the road and it's a little breezy.

pointers.title: The Left Hand Grab
pointers.summary: You're going to go down under or go to New Zealand and do a race where they're on the left hand side of the road.

pointers.title: The Climb
pointers.summary: You're about to climb a hill and you're on your triathlon bike, which is not the easiest bike to climb hills with.

pointers.title: Sausage Roll Wetsuit
pointers.summary: You're coming down to go to out to a beautiful swim or you're about to start your race.

pointers.title: Melt Down
pointers.summary: You're about to go for a nice swim and it's summertime, so you go and get your swim cap out of your closet and you notice that they're stuck together.

pointers.title: What To Wear
pointers.summary: It's right stay morning and you're about to go down to the swim start.

pointers.title: It's A Contact Sport
pointers.summary: You're in your triathlon swim and it's crowded and you're getting hit.

pointers.title: It's Black
pointers.summary: You're out to go out swimming with your swim buddies and you've got swim caps and everyone's ready to go.

pointers.title: Avoid The Zero Mph Fall (B.U.B.S.)
pointers.summary: You just got your first set of bike shoes and you've got your pedals.

pointers.title: Tongue Tied
pointers.summary: You've gone out for your training run and it feels like there's a rock in your shoe or something.

pointers.title: Key Dilemma
pointers.summary: It's a beautiful day to go for a swim in the ocean and you have all your belongings that you've left in your car.

pointers.title: Un-Blistify Toes
pointers.summary: You're going out for your long training runs and you tend to get blisters on your toes.

pointers.title: Maximize Energy
pointers.summary: You're out for your long training runs and you want to make sure that you are as efficient as possible.
